name: My Bloodsucking 9-to-5
source:
Your name is James. You're an average joe, crunching numbers all night for an uncaring company. Also you're a vampire. And someone stole your lunch.

[From [url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/my-bloodsucking-nine-to-five-gj]Itch.io[/url]]

你的名字是詹姆斯。你是一个普通人，整夜为一家冷漠的公司处理数字。而且你也是吸血鬼。有人偷了你的午餐。

[来自[url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/my-bloodsucking-nine-to-five-gj]Itch.io[/url]]
